join.title: Ready to join the
join.desc: One form, 4 questions, ~5 minutes. We review applications every Friday and reply by the following Tuesday — yes, even if the answer is “not yet.”
join.step1Desc: 4 questions about your role, time zone, and what you'd contribute.
join.step2Desc: Two existing members read each application. ~5% rejection rate.
join.step3Desc: Intro yourself in #introductions. Lurk or contribute — both are fine.

hero.title: 500+ remote-working Vietnamese,
hero.desc: Engineers, designers, marketers, ops people — all working remotely for companies abroad. We trade offer letters, debug async culture, and meet up in person when we're in the same city.
hero.vetted: Vetted by current members. We look for senior craft and good-faith participation — not vibes.

members.title: The people
members.desc: A small slice of who you'll meet. Everyone's vetted, everyone's remote, everyone's working for a company outside Vietnam.

1.quote: After two years, I finally figured out how to do deep work in PJs without losing my mind.

2.quote: The async culture here means my best work happens between 5–11pm. The team in SF doesn't blink.

3.quote: Six timezones, zero standups. The PRs and docs do all the talking.

4.quote: Living in a tea farm town. Working on growth across 5 SEA markets. Wild, honestly.
